title: Concept: MD5 selected through MessageDigest in kotlin — review required
description: In kotlin, MD5 is selected through the standard JVM MessageDigest API. The call looks like ordinary cryptography, but collisions can be generated on demand and the digest is far too fast to resist guessing. When it protects passwords or signed tokens, the security margin is gone regardless of how the value is later encoded.
applicability: kotlin Android and JVM applications that hash values.
risk: Collision and brute-force attacks on protected values; MEDIUM severity.
